threads.assignment: Shared contracts only. Export every new public API named in the roadmap from the package indexes: PositionalEncoding from torch_geometric/nn/__init__.py; SSGConv and WLConvContinuous from torch_geometric/nn/conv/__init__.py; dropout_node, dropout_edge, shuffle_node, mask_feature, add_random_edge and assortativity from torch_geometric/utils/__init__.py; IndexToMask, MaskToIndex, FeaturePropagation and AddRandomMetaPaths from torch_geometric/transforms/__init__.py; and ExplainerConfig, ModelConfig, ThresholdConfig, Explanation, Explainer, the ExplainerAlgorithm base and DummyExplainer from the new torch_geometric/explain/__init__.py and torch_geometric/explain/algorithm/__init__.py. A stub module per API with the roadmap's exact signature is enough where the module does not exist yet; other threads implement them. Nothing else.

Target 1 (New Neural Network Modules) and Target 4 (Fused Aggregation): implement SSGConv and WLConvContinuous under torch_geometric/nn/conv, PositionalEncoding under torch_geometric/nn, and FusedAggregation in torch_geometric/nn/aggr/fused.py (with any changes it needs elsewhere in torch_geometric/nn/aggr), with tests under test/nn. The package exports belong to t0.

Target 2 (Graph Augmentation Utilities), Target 3 (New Data Transforms) and Target 6 (Graph Metrics and Meta-path Utilities): implement dropout_node, dropout_edge, shuffle_node, mask_feature, add_random_edge and assortativity under torch_geometric/utils, and IndexToMask, MaskToIndex, FeaturePropagation and AddRandomMetaPaths under torch_geometric/transforms, with tests under test/utils and test/transforms. The package exports belong to t0.

Target 5 (Explainability Framework): implement ExplainerConfig, ModelConfig, ThresholdConfig, Explanation, Explainer, the ExplainerAlgorithm base and DummyExplainer under torch_geometric/explain, with tests under test/explain. The two package __init__ files belong to t0.
